mapper.insert: INSERT INTO party_member (party_id, user_id, job_code, joined_at) VALUES (#{partyId}, #{userId}, #{jobCode}, #{joinedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS id, u.user_name AS nickname, u.job_class_code AS job, jc.name AS job_name, u.mbti AS mbti, CASE WHEN u.id = p.leader_id THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_leader FROM party_member pm JOIN user u ON pm.user_id = u.id JOIN job_class jc ON u.job_class_code = jc.code JOIN party p ON pm.party_id = p.id WHERE pm.party_id = #{partyId}
